title: Clay G9 — EPOCH: Epoched Projection, Orchestration & Causal-Handoff Kernel
core_findings: Selection integrity is distinct from record provenance for graph-selected effect-bound evidence.
ClayCode should execute deterministic state semantics before projecting unresolved semantic alternatives to an LLM.
Immutable semantic epochs + delta overlays + lazy sparse activation form a plausible low-cost memory substrate, but ClayGraph G1d remains HOLD.
Compaction/rebuild should be workload/read-aware; one fixed threshold and one scalar maintenance-debt objective are rejected as universal.
Fast exact/FTS retrieval plus relational/uncertainty-gated graph escalation is the preferred target architecture, not universal graph hot-path traversal.
GWT causal work must orthogonalize GRAPH_PRIOR x WORKSPACE_SELECTION x PROJECTION x REENTRY; bundled lesions can manufacture apparent workspace effects.
Projection integrity requires semantic as well as hash/basis/schema checks; trusted miscompile is a separate failure class.
Persistent latent activation is not emergence; causal Assembly lesion/rescue/OOD controls remain required.
negative_results: always graph hot path not promoted
maintenance debt scalar not universally superior
compiled model projection still not deterministic authority
